name: LRV
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 运行于轻轨交通系统中的轨道车辆。
usage_overview: 在轻轨车辆—高架桥地震响应分析中，轻轨车辆作为移动载体参与耦合计算；其多体模型由车体、转向架、轮对及两级悬挂组成，用于模拟车辆与桥梁的动力相互作用。

complete_examples.text: Therefore, the original contribution of this manuscript could potentially claim is concerning the elastoplastic seismic analysis of TTBCS emphasising the running safety of the LRV.

The study attempts to simulate the plastic deformation of the reinforced concrete (RC) light rail transit bridge (LRTB) based on the dynamic substructuring method (DSM), which is closely related to the stability problems of the LRV.
